Single-Cell RNA-seq.sample_type: CD3-positive T cells from lungs, lung-draining lymph nodes, bone marrow, and peripheral blood
Single-Cell RNA-seq.readouts: single-cell transcript sequences and gene expression profiles

evidence.quote: We pooled all of the libraries for a given donor, each of which was barcoded with a unique Illumina sample index, for sequencing in a single Illumina flow cell.

proliferation assays.sample_type: magnetically enriched CD3-positive T cells from single cell suspensions
proliferation assays.readouts: cell division tracked by Cell Proliferation Dye eFluor 450 fluorescence together with CD25 and NME1 expression

evidence.quote: For stimulation/proliferation assays, we magnetically enriched for CD3 + T cells from single cell suspensions, stained cells with Cell Proliferation Dye eFluor 450 (eBioscience), and cultured cells for up to 120 h with or without TCR stimulation as above.

Quantitative real-time PCR.standard_technique_name: real time reverse-transcription polymerase chain reaction
Quantitative real-time PCR.sample_type: sorted live CD4-positive and CD8-positive T cells from peripheral blood mononuclear cells
Quantitative real-time PCR.readouts: NME1, IL2RA, IFIT3, and TBP cDNA amplification measured as cycle threshold-based fold changes

evidence.quote: We converted RNA to cDNA via SuperScript IV VILO Master Mix (Invitrogen) and performed quantitative real-time PCR (qPCR) on a Viia 7 Real-Time PCR system (Applied Biosystems) using TaqMan Gene Expression Assays (NME1 Hs00264824_m1; IL2RA Hs00907777_m1; IFIT3 Hs00155468_m1; TBP Hs00427620_m1) and TaqMan Fast Advanced Master Mix, all from ThermoFisher Scientific.

Flow cytometry and proliferation assays.readouts: T cell surface marker fluorescence and intracellular NME1 protein expression

evidence.quote: We acquired cell fluorescence data using a BD LSR II flow cytometer and used FCS Express (De Novo Software) for analysis.
